title: Assumption
description: Schema for assumptions made by agents during PDCA execution, managed via /u-assume

agent.description: Agent that made the assumption (e.g., u-agent-ra, u-agent-sa)

context.description: Context in which the assumption was made (phase, document, task)

question.description: The question or ambiguity that led to the assumption

impact.description: List of documents or items affected if assumption is wrong

rejectionReason.description: Reason for rejection, null if not rejected
